q1_what_did_you_play: I played Kaboom! on Nibbit, then Jumpy Dumpty on Nibbit. Fwoosh! was unplayable because the Spark bank is empty and the card is blocked by card logic. I did not play Duck and Cover because the telegraphed 12 damage is survivable at 40 HP.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing both Kaboom! cards plus Duck and Cover for 14 damage and 5 Block, but I rejected it because the enemy's 12 damage does not threaten me and the extra damage from Jumpy Dumpty is more valuable than 5 Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The chosen line gave up 5 Block from Duck and Cover. It also gave up playing the second Kaboom!, but Jumpy Dumpty's 16 damage more than replaces that missing 7 damage while using the same total energy.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If the enemy intent had been a much larger attack where 5 Block could be the difference between surviving and dying, I would have considered or chosen the two Kaboom! plus Duck and Cover line. The printed 12 attack does not make that tradeoff worthwhile.
